name: room
text: Room opened — goal: visualization: Own EXCAVA'S OWN interface — visibility, liveliness, clarity, enjoyment, speed of OUR scre

name: Facet
text: Ship EXCAVA with a one-time theme picker at first launch, defaulting to dark. This keeps the interface consistent with Manus and Graphify, reducing cognitive load for users who switch between tools. The trade-off is a slight delay in first-time setup, but it ensures long-term clarity and enjoyment.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A one-time picker still forces a decision users may not care about—most won’t switch themes later, so we waste their first launch on a trivial choice. Instead, default to dark based on system preference; it’s the safer default, aligns with Manus and Graphify, and removes the friction. Settle it by testing first-launch drop-off rates with and without the picker.
